points: None of your 20 written ads shows a proof number, so a club comparing suppliers has nothing solid to trust. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
3 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product in the ad, so the click lands with no reason to buy. Point each to the product page for the item its copy names, and keep the same copy.
0 of 20 written ads name an offer for a first-time buyer, so new clubs have no reason to click. Give buyers one reason to act today, like a first order offer or bundle, in line one of the new ads.

Your 2 ads running 60+ days are proven winners, yet none of the 25 newer ads reuses their opening line. Build the next batch as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its first line and changing the product.
